summary: Backend testing completed for Euphoria Hackathon Registration Platform. Created comprehensive pytest suite covering health, hackathon/clubs content, registration success/validation, duplicate detection, and admin auth+CRUD+export. All 27 tests pass after fixing one critical bug in JWT admin auth (UUID casting).

critical.issue: get_current_admin was passing JWT sub (str) directly to SQLAlchemy Uuid column, causing 500 'str object has no attribute hex' on every admin request. Fixed by casting to uuid.UUID.

critical_code_review_comments: schemas/registration.py: internal-team accommodation validation raises INVALID_ACCOMMODATION when accommodation_type is missing; consider a more specific ACCOMMODATION_TYPE_REQUIRED code for clarity.

public.py: HTTPException status mapping uses `exc.code.endswith(('EXISTS','REGISTERED'))` - PARTICIPANT_ALREADY_REGISTERED and REGISTRATION_FAILED both end with matching suffixes; consider an explicit status map.
security.py: SECRET_KEY is read via os.environ (KeyError if missing); ensure /app/backend/.env sets SECRET_KEY (currently working).
admin.py: set_cookie uses secure=True which will not work on non-HTTPS local dev; acceptable behind ingress but may hurt local dev.
admin.py: /api/admin/registrations/export must be defined before /{registration_id} for correct route ordering. Currently ordered correctly - keep this way.
No brute-force lockout on admin login (task mentions expectation). Not implemented - flagged to main agent.
seed_data_creation: Test suite creates multiple teams with unique tags each run; no cleanup implemented (SQLite dev DB). Every test uses unique uuid-based emails/phones/euphoria_ids.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully validated at 100%. One critical fix applied in /app/backend/app/core/security.py (UUID casting for JWT sub). Admin login returns access_token; use Authorization: Bearer header. Error responses are either {detail: {code, message}} (from service) with 4xx or Pydantic 422 with list of errors (custom codes appear in msg). Duplicate detection works across cases; team name normalized as trimmed+lowercased+collapsed-spaces. Ready for frontend testing.
rca of the issue: get_current_admin decoded JWT payload.get('sub') as a plain str and passed to `Admin.id == admin_id` where Admin.id is Uuid type. SQLAlchemy Uuid processor calls value.hex causing AttributeError, surfacing as HTTP 500 on all admin endpoints. Fix: uuid.UUID(payload.get('sub')) with ValueError/TypeError caught -> 401. Reproduction: login, then GET /api/admin/statistics with Bearer token -> was 500. Post-fix: 200.
